state: Prespecified final method and assessment declaration; prospective generation requires a separate source freeze manifest.
purpose: Test one native cached-plan selection rule: replace an audited valid cache only for strict same-snapshot joint-fee reduction; retain fee ties/costlier proposals. Keep original native HiGHS, adaptive V9, V7 and stable V5 unchanged. Retain every negative result.

generator.independence: Every business scenario has a new unique base seed across both panels. Three repeated algorithm seeds/timing runs share that one business scenario and are not independent business samples. Do not replace infeasible, duplicate, slow or costly cases.

panels.interpretation: Unchanged V9 generator and same four shock patterns; new independent business seeds not generated or inspected in development.
Unchanged V9 stress patterns: repeated/unannounced-recovery/sequential-resource/gradual-recovery. All initial orders known; no planner sees future events or private durations.

shockCapacityRule: For each event: capacity=max(0, nominal capacity on revealDay-ceil(nominal*reductionNumerator/reductionDenominator)). Only simulator receives duration. No announcedDuration.

budget.execution: Cold separate POSIX process group per episode; all methods execute serially, cyclic method order changes by scenario and repeat. Python descendants are group-killed on timeout and after worker exit.
budget.clock: Parent time starts before fork; includes imports, planner.ready native startup, all decisions, child terminal dual audit, planner.close cleanup, IPC and parent receipt audit. Only receipts fully validated by 5000ms count as complete.
budget.callBudgetCaveat: V5 uses legacy solver-internal seconds; V7/adaptiveV9/original native HiGHS/stable native V10 use cooperative whole-call milliseconds. Native startup is charged to parent 5000ms and separately reported. All old baseline call configurations are unchanged; stable native V10 has identical configuration to original native HiGHS. No observer or parent candidate acknowledgement affects formal daily acceptance.

analysis.repeatAggregation: Equal scenario weighting: within each pair, average matching jointly completed repeats in each scenario, then aggregate scenario means. Also disclose raw paired episode totals and paired-repeat counts.
analysis.panels: Always separate. Do not pool same-distribution and stress into a ranking.
analysis.defaultGate: All recorded scenario-repeat completion pairs count. Any completion loss against any old baseline prevents default recommendation eligibility; finite-sample zero loss is not a production recommendation or a universal guarantee.
analysis.nativeStabilityClaim: Claim conditional stability improvement only for zero native completion losses, strictly fewer pending-event-date revisions on exactly native jointly completed repeats, and neither total nor incremental fee 95% savings interval wholly negative. Both intervals required. Fee CI containing zero means no stable fee advantage; zero is not removed with a sign tolerance.
analysis.revisionUnit: One changed pending pickup/unloadStart/return date; count events, never convert revisions to KRW with invented weights.
analysis.jointCompletePareto: Additional all-five-method jointly complete matching-repeat subset. Average matching repeats within each eligible scenario, then sum equal-weight scenario means for total/incremental KRW and revision events separately. Show all denominators and full-sample completion. Dominance requires fee/revisions both no worse and one strictly better (EPS 1e-6). Unknown revisions produce null, never zero. No weighted score or pooled ranking.

freezePolicy: Before the first prospective generation: finish methods and independent review, fix all budget/parameter/analysis declarations, freeze all source and protocol SHA256 in a new artifacts directory. Verify live and frozen source hashes, then import both generator and workers from the frozen source snapshot. No prospective input generation or trial runs before root-authorized freeze; no replacing negative cases or overwriting a first run.
analysisRules: 144 new scenarios (72 per panel) x 3 retained algorithm/timing repeats x 5 methods = 2160 episodes, not 432 independent business scenarios. Preserve previous V8/V9 first runs/negative outcomes; old inputs are development only.
Keep all failures, parent deadline losses, late first receipts, audit rejections, unknown histories, zeros, negative savings and completion gains/losses. No seed selection or case replacement.
Incomplete episode fees are null. Missing history, revisions and counters are null/unavailable, never zero.

Report V10 vs original native HiGHS/adaptive V9/V7/stable V5 and original native HiGHS vs V7. Each pair uses its own matching jointly completed repeats for fees/revisions; never rank across different conditional denominators.

Default eligibility requires zero completion losses against every old baseline across all full-sample matching repeats. Any loss prevents default recommendation; zero observed losses is not universal non-regression.

Report total/incremental fee numerator/denominator, win/tie/loss, worst losses, event-date revisions and scenario-cluster bootstrap intervals. A native fee CI containing zero permits only no stable fee advantage.

Conditional stability improvement vs original native HiGHS requires zero native completion losses, strictly fewer revisions on that same jointly completed set, and no robust fee deterioration: both fee CIs available and neither savings CI wholly below zero. Do not invent KRW revision weights.

Also report an all-five jointly completed set with explicit scenario/episode denominators and separate fee/revision Pareto tables. Conditional Pareto position never overrides full-sample completion losses.
Full-path tests use different initial plans and do not isolate recovery after a shared physical prefix.

Only synthetic known-order daily atomic truck/warehouse/staging conclusions supported. Native HiGHS is a same-model reference; no enterprise ROI, production suitability, universal non-regression or first-place guarantee.

Retain full histories, observations, decisions, adaptiveV9 candidateDelivery, stable-native stabilitySelection proofs, all rejected candidates and terminal audits with hashes; compact only redundant debug/cache pricing.
First-run artifacts/repeats never overwritten. Reproduction requires a new output. Disclose duplicate order-list fingerprints without resampling.

deliveryEvidence.policy: Unchanged adaptiveV9 synchronous gate; V10 native selection proof retained without an IPC acceptance stream.
deliveryEvidence.retention: Retain complete receipt sequence, dates, independently reconstructed fees, timing fields, accepted and rejected gate outcomes without truncation. Internal constructor firstIncumbentMs is not acceptance evidence.
deliveryEvidence.unknownHistory: No timely whole-episode terminal receipt means complete fees, execution counters and history remain null/unavailable; absence of gate evidence is not proof that no candidate physically existed.
deliveryEvidence.nativeSelection: Keep complete pristine same-snapshot before/proposal/after dates, repriced fees, physical/lock audits, actual outer timestamps and selection. Internal fees/times do not establish acceptance.

developmentSeparation.previousRuns: All V8/V9 original first runs and negative outcomes unchanged; already seen inputs are development only.
developmentSeparation.newSeeds: 491001..491072 and 492001..492072 are prospective commitments; no generation, inspection, tuning or trial before root-authorized source freeze.
developmentSeparation.budgetSelection: Original 200ms daily and 5000ms cold episode limits; no budget selection from prospective results.
developmentSeparation.methodsOmitted: V8/V6 omitted to preserve five methods/2160 episodes; unchanged adaptiveV9, V7, V5 and original native HiGHS retained.

nativeSelectionRule.change: Replace a valid independently audited cache only when canonical native joint fee < canonical cache joint fee - 1e-6. Retain ties/costlier proposals. Invalid/absent cache uses original recovery. No extra solve, lexicographic solve, KRW revision weight or tuned threshold.
